facts: Dio supports interceptors, cancellation, upload progress, FormData, and timeouts.

en.label: Flutter HTTP client
en.name: Dio
en.summary: A practical client with interceptors, transforms, and cancellation.
en.description: The usual production HTTP layer in Flutter. Retrofit generates Dio clients. You should pin timeouts and interceptor order as a team.
tradeOffs: Unconfigured clients diverge across the team
